stem.en: A car of mass 1200 kg moves at 25 m/s. The driver brakes until the car stops. How much work do the brakes do on the car? Give the sign, in joules.

explanation.en: The car's kinetic energy is 1/2 x 1200 x 25^2 = 600 x 625 = 375 000 J. The brakes remove all of it, pushing against the motion, so they do -375 000 J of work. The energy becomes heat and sound.

hints.en: Find the kinetic energy first: 1/2 mv^2.
The brakes push against the motion, so their work is negative.
